one_line: Async Playwright Booking.com scraper (multi-city search + 3 concurrent detail workers; hotel name/address/lat-lon/property type, room types, per-room pricing plans, cancellation policies, amenities, reviews); MIT, 3 stars, 30 KB, code in booking_scraper/ plus a 195-byte cities.booking.json; created and last pushed 12 Feb 2026 (scout's Aug 2026 date is wrong); no dataset committed.
abnb_use: Gaps 9 and 2, and indirectly 3: it extracts room-level cancellation policies and pricing plans alongside nightly price, which is the closest public analogue to the RNPL (reserve-now-pay-later) cancellation-mix question if a Booking.com panel were ever authorised.
reasoning: Confirmed it is code only — root holds run.py, booking_scraper/, a tiny city config and an MIT licence, with no committed output. It is the most capable of the Booking.com scrapers seen so far (JS rendering, room-level cancellation-policy extraction), which is why it is worth a catalogue line as a method. Running it touches a third-party site's anti-bot defences, so it stays unrun pending a human ToS call.

one_line: Small self-hosted PHP iCal merger (icalmerger.php, 5 KB) that unions a host's Airbnb / Booking.com / Atraveo availability feeds into one calendar; no licence, 41 stars, last push Jan 2020; ships one real merged calendar ics/allservices.ics (2.9 KB) for an Austrian rental (kuenstlerzimmer.at) whose VEVENTs carry the booking channel in SUMMARY (e.g. ATRAVEO) with DTSTART/DTEND date ranges through 2019.
abnb_use: Gaps 2 and 9: the committed ics is a single-listing, channel-tagged booked-nights calendar — a worked example of what a per-listing occupancy record with channel mix and length-of-stay looks like, and documents the iCal mechanism by which a non-Airbnb (Booking/Vrbo/Atraveo) availability panel could be assembled from host-held feeds rather than scraping.
sample_plan: curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pixelcrash/Sync-Rentals-Calendar/HEAD/ics/allservices.ics -o allservices.ics (2.9 KB) and curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pixelcrash/Sync-Rentals-Calendar/HEAD/icalmerger.php -o icalmerger.php (5 KB). Total under 10 KB; do not clone vendor/. Do not run the tool — it needs a host's private feed URLs.
reasoning: Verified the ics/ directory holds one genuine merged rental calendar with per-channel booking blocks, not a template, so there is a tiny concrete artefact worth pulling for the length-of-stay / channel-mix illustration. The tool itself only works with a host's own private iCal URLs, so it is a mechanism note, not a bulk source, and the repo carries no licence. Dormant since 2020.
